# MA Links — Agricultural Export Profile & Wholesale Supplier Information

> MA Links is an established Pakistani agricultural export enterprise specializing in wholesale supply, phytosanitary compliance, and cold-chain logistics for fresh fruits, premium dry fruits, and commercial vegetables. Sourced directly from orchards in Multan and the Punjab agricultural belt, MA Links supplies B2B import and distribution companies across Europe, the Middle East, North America, and Southeast Asia.

## Country of Export Origin
- **Country**: Pakistan
- **Primary Growing Region**: Multan, Punjab Agricultural Belt & Northern Forest Regions
- **Primary Export Ports**: Karachi Port (Sea Cargo - Port Qasim / KPT), Karachi Jinnah International Airport (Air Cargo - KHI)

## Main Product Lines & Seasonality

### 1. Fresh Mangoes (Summer Season: May – September)
- **Chaunsa Mango**: Sweet & aromatic, high Brix sugar content, Grade A export caliber (4kg/5kg cartons). VHT/Hot Water treated.
- **Sindhri Mango**: Large caliber, fiberless flesh, long transit shelf-life.
- **Anwar Ratol Mango**: Compact size, concentrated sweetness and legendary aroma.
- **Langra Mango**: Green-skinned at maturity, sweet-acid flavor profile.
- **Dusehri Mango**: Elongated, smooth pulp, high juiciness.
- **Saroli Mango**: Early season summer harvester.

### 2. Fresh Fruits (Off-Season & Winter: August – March)
- **Kinnow Citrus (Mandarin)**: 50%+ juice yield, wax-coated for 45+ days reefer transit (Dec – Mar). Top export volume (2.7M tonnes domestic production capacity).
- **Winter Guava**: White flesh, crisp texture, foam-netted in 5kg cartons (Aug – Dec).
- **Ruby Red Pomegranate**: High juice & antioxidant yield, Grade A 3.5kg open-top trays (Aug – Dec).
- **Fresh Dates (Rutab / Aseel)**: Semi-ripe fresh date clusters in clamshells (Sept – Nov).

### 3. Dry Fruits & Nuts (Year-Round & Q4 Peak)
- **Walnuts (Akhrot)**: In-shell (30mm+) and extra light kernels (Oct – Dec).
- **Pine Nuts (Chilgoza)**: Wild-harvested Himalayan pine nut kernels, nitrogen-flushed vacuum pouches (Aug – Dec).
- **Dried Figs (Anjeer)**: Naturally sun-dried, calibrated size categories (Late Autumn – Winter).
- **Dried Dates (Chuhara)**: Hard cured yellow and black dates, 12+ months ambient shelf life (Year-round).

### 4. Commercial Vegetables (Autumn Crop: October – December)
- **Export Onions**: Red and golden varieties, 45mm–70mm+, high dry matter for 30+ day sea transit.
- **Fresh Potatoes**: Mozika & Santana varieties, washed/unwashed, 45mm–75mm.

## Export & B2B Logistics Specifications
- **Incoterms Supported**: FOB Karachi (Port / Airport), CIF Destination Port, CFR Destination Port.
- **Shipping Modes**: Air Freight (3–5 days lead time), Sea Reefer Container FCL 20ft/40ft (10–21 days transit).
- **Packaging Formats**: 3kg/4kg/5kg corrugated cartons, 10kg/13kg/14kg telescopic citrus boxes, 10kg/25kg mesh bags, vacuum-sealed bags.
- **Phytosanitary Protocol**: Hot Water Dip Treatment (HWDT) / Vapour Heat Treatment (VHT) as mandated by importing country plant health authorities.

## Certifications & Regulatory Standards
- **Phytosanitary Export Certificate**: Issued by the Department of Plant Protection (DPP), Ministry of National Food Security & Research, Government of Pakistan (Active).
